summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, reporting the detailed final voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on April 15, 2026. The agenda was a routine item: reviewing management accounts and annual financial statements for FY 2025. The document contains a shareholder-by-shareholder voting map showing votes for, against, and abstentions. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. As a routine AGM results filing, it does not constitute a special situation.
